name: LOOSE (Lucy Hickling)
bio: Fred's creative director and tour photographer. Directed the videos for Clara and places to be, co-directed stayinit, and filmed the early Actual Life videos.

name: Theo Batterham
bio: Has been photographing Fred's world for about five years, from the 2021 Mixmag cover shoot to the USB002 residencies and the first Asia shows.
source: Milk Studios / The Agents Club; DJ Mag; Instagram (17 tags)

name: Charlie Hutchins
bio: Behind the camera on early videos (2021), the fan-made Hannah (the sun) video, and a film-camera photo series from the first Asia shows.

name: Donny Dop
bio: Filmed the Julia video (2020) and the 2021 Actual Life videos with LOOSE.

name: Jamie Tinsley
bio: Runs the sound at all of Fred's live shows.

name: Matt Pittman
bio: Production and lighting design for the live show.

name: Ed Warren
bio: Designed the lighting and lasers for the Skrillex / Fred / Four Tet Madison Square Garden rave.

name: Explorers Club (Aaron Skipper)
bio: LA studio behind the USB002 tour identity, built so fans could remix it themselves.

name: rubberband. (Jason Sondock & Simon Davis)
bio: Directed the 2026 trilogy of black-and-white slow-motion videos, including Lights Burn Dimmer.

name: 2ms studio
bio: Worked with Fred on the first live show from February 2020 and the Angie video.

name: Boris Acket
bio: Made the moving kinetic systems for a recent Fred tour.
